name: Low Discrepancy View Sampling
definition: An acquisition strategy for dynamic CT that distributes projection angles uniformly over time using a low discrepancy sequence, ensuring all Np projection angles are unique to maximize information extraction from each additional projection, while decomposing into linear scan rounds compatible with hardware constraints.
summary: Low Discrepancy View Sampling distributes projection angles uniformly over time using a Van der Corput sequence, ensuring all angles are unique unlike random or interlaced methods.
